AHCINT 1.3.0.0-usos4 - MODIFIED version of AHCINT 1.3.0.0 (ages2001,
https://github.com/ages2001/AHCINT, tag v1.3.0.0 = commit 7be9c9b8), changed
by the USOS project on 2026-09-30 (usos1), 2026-10-03 (usos2) and
2026-10-04 (usos3, usos4). Not an upstream release. Licence: GPL-3.0, as the original (LICENSE).

usos1 (patches/0001-usos1-flush-cache.patch):
- SYNCHRONIZE CACHE (10)/(16), SRB_FUNCTION_FLUSH and SRB_FUNCTION_SHUTDOWN
  send FLUSH CACHE (E7h) or FLUSH CACHE EXT (EAh) to the drive; FUA writes
  are followed by a flush; MODE SENSE returns the caching page (WCE from
  IDENTIFY word 85).

usos2 (patches/0002-usos2-target-check-and-trace.patch), after the first X470
run, where text-mode Setup copied files but nothing reached the disk:
- Before every command the port must have a link (SSTS.DET = 3) and a
  running command engine (PxCMD ST, FRE, CR, FR); otherwise the port is
  restarted once and the command fails instead of being issued.
- Counters (reads, writes, sectors written, errors, PRD byte count
  mismatches, engine restarts, flushes); a PRD byte count that does not
  match the request is counted.
- The USOS gap: on the one disk whose LBA 2046 holds the USOS marker
  ("USOSW2KTRACE", written by tools/w2k_stage.sh usos_w2k_gap_marker), the
  driver writes and reads back a test pattern at LBA 2045 at every start; a
  mismatch hides the port from Setup ("no hard disk" instead of copying
  into nothing). It increments the boot counter in the marker and writes an
  ASCII trace (counters, every port's SSTS/CMD/SIG/TFD and model) to LBA
  2040 + boot % 4, again every 2048 writes and at shutdown. Other disks are only read at LBA
  2046.

usos3 (patches/0003-usos3-screen-stages-readback-fail-loudly.patch), a
diagnostic build after the second X470 run (text mode copied with its
progress bar, then a black screen with a blinking cursor; nothing on the
disk, not even the usos2 marker update):
- A status line per HBA in the VGA text buffer (row 0, a second HBA row 1):
  PCI ID, port, marker result at LBA 2046 (OK / NO / RE read error), the
  write test, completed reads and writes, errors, last written LBA and the
  stages; refreshed every 64 commands, on every error and every stage.
  Reads rising during the file copy show that AHCINT is the driver serving
  the disk.
- Stages (status line and trace): first write to LBA 0, first write over
  LBA 2048, first flush, shutdown, read-back failure, write/read error,
  bugcheck. The first four written LBAs, the last error (LBA, TFD, command)
  and read-back counters are in the trace (now only ports with a device).
- Sampled read-back on the USOS disk: the first sector of the first 256
  writes and of every 32nd after is read back and compared.
- Fail loudly: a marker read that fails 3 times, a failed write test or a
  read-back mismatch stops with STOP 0x55534F53 (P1 1/2/3, P2 PCI ID,
  P3 port, P4 TFD or LBA) after the line and the trace are written (usos2
  returned silently or hid the port).
- A bugcheck callback puts the STOP code on the line and writes it to the
  trace (AHCINT polls, so this works with every other CPU stopped).
Imports added: MmMapIoSpace, KeRegisterBugCheckCallback, KeBugCheckEx,
KiBugCheckData (ntoskrnl, all on 2000 SP4).

usos4 (patches/0004-usos4-stall-diagnostics.patch), a diagnostic build after
the X470 run where text-mode Setup stopped at 4 % of the copy with the
status line frozen and no STOP:
- The status line is refreshed after every command (usos3: every 64th) and
  by a 250 ms miniport timer, in a shorter format with new fields:
  A4 43C8p2 OK/OK R:01A2F3 W:003F10 E:00 B:0 LW:00A1B2C3 S:0F I:000 TM:3A1 ID:00
  B = HwResetBus calls (ScsiPort request timeouts), I = HwInterrupt calls
  (AHCINT polls, so none are expected), TM = timer ticks (ScsiPort runs the
  timer synchronized with HwStartIo, so TM stops while a command is polled),
  ID = seconds without a new request. A second HBA now uses row 8 (rows
  1-7 are usosrst's).
- Stall watchdog: a polled command still busy after 2 s puts PxCI, PxSACT,
  PxIS, PxSERR, PxTFD, PxCMD, the HBA IS, poll/irq (GHC.IE and PxIE), the
  command (opcode, LBA, count), the interrupt count and the stall count on
  rows 3-4; when the command ends or times out (3 s) the same snapshot is
  written to the trace ("slow" or "stall").
- The trace (usos4 format, fields in minimal hex so the snapshot fits):
  interrupt, timer, request, idle, bus reset and stall counters, the
  snapshot, GHC and HBA IS, PxCI/PxIS/PxSERR per port; also written on
  every bus reset ("busreset") and once after 20 s without a new request
  ("idle20s"). tools/w2k_gap_trace.py decodes it.
No new imports (ScsiPortNotification RequestTimerCall).

Every changed spot in src/ is marked "MODIFIED (USOS 1.3.0.0-usosN)".
Built with WDK 7.1 (build.cmd, x86 WXP target); every import (16: ntoskrnl,
scsiport) resolves on the Windows 2000 SP4 kernel and scsiport.

NT 4.0 build (2026-10-07, same source, no change to the 2000/XP binary):
- build-nt4.cmd and src/NT4WDK (sources, makefile) build ahcint.sys with
  WDK 7.1 and -DAHCI_NT4 -DAHCI_NT4_WDK into bin/NT4/i386/ahcint.sys.
  AHCI_NT4 is upstream's own NT 3.50/3.51/4.0 path (non-PnP ScsiPort: no
  HBA reset, the ABAR access range claimed, INTx from config space).
- ahcimain.c DriverEntry (AHCI_NT4_WDK only): HwInitializationDataSize is
  FIELD_OFFSET(HW_INITIALIZATION_DATA, HwAdapterControl) = 0x4C, the size
  NT 4.0 ScsiPort accepts (the NT4 and SP6a ScsiPortInitialize both refuse
  anything larger); the WDK 7.1 header adds HwAdapterControl (0x50).
- tools/nt4/pe_nt4_version.py sets the PE OS/subsystem version to 4.00
  (the WDK 7.1 linker writes 5.00) and the PE checksum.
Every import (16: ntoskrnl, scsiport) resolves on the NT 4.0 RTM (1381.1)
and SP6a (1381.335) kernels and scsiport (tools/tests/check_nt4_driver_imports.py).
- ahcimain.c AhciFindAdapter (AHCI_NT4 without AHCI_W9X, patch 0006,
  2026-10-07): BusInterruptLevel and BusInterruptVector are 0, so NT 4.0
  ScsiPort connects no interrupt (every command completes in HwStartIo,
  GHC.IE and PxIE stay off). With INTx from config space, QEMU OVMF +
  CSMWrap stopped with 0x7B: ScsiPort dropped the adapter after HwFindAdapter, HwInitialize was
  never called (likely cause: no MP-table PCI interrupt entry for the HBA
  under CSMWrap). The 9x build keeps INTx (SCSIPORT.PDR), 2000/XP unchanged.
- ahcisatl.c (patch 0007, NT 3.51 build only, 2026-10-08): with AHCI_NT351
  the bugcheck trace does not import KiBugCheckData (NT 3.51 ntoskrnl does
  not export it) and records the STOP code as 0. build-nt351.cmd builds
  bin/NT351/i386/ahcint.sys with the NT 4.0 defines plus -DAHCI_NT351 and
  PE version 3.51; every import resolves on NT 3.51
  (tools/tests/data/nt351_exports.txt). The other builds are unchanged.

usos5 (patches/0008-usos5-readback-mismatch-not-fatal.patch, 2026-10-09;
same folder, all three binaries rebuilt): a sampled read-back mismatch
(usos3) no longer stops the machine. AHCINT DMAs a write straight from the
caller's pages and compared the read-back with those same pages after the
command; Windows lets a mapped or paged-out page change while its write is
in flight (the page is dirtied again and written later), so the compare can
differ without anything being wrong on the disk. On the X470 (16 threads,
2000 Server SP4 uses up to 4 CPUs) GUI Setup stopped at "Registering
components" with STOP 0x55534F53 (00000003, 43C81022, 00000002, 01E69238) =
read-back mismatch, AMD 400-series SATA (1022:43C8), port 2, LBA 01E69238.
Now the mismatch is counted (rbbad), the first LBA is kept (trace field
rblba) and one trace record "rb-mismatch" is written; stage bit 10 stays on
the status line, which no longer turns red for it. The marker-read (P1 1)
and write-test (P1 2) STOPs at start are unchanged. The trace header still
reads "AHCINT 1.3.0.0-usos4" (tools/w2k_gap_trace.py keys on it).
